name: theme-wallpaper
description: Box theming: sets the desktop wallpaper (system + per-user XFCE/LXQt + /etc/skel + GNOME/MATE dconf default + LightDM/GDM greeter background). Reads $WALLPAPER_FILENAME, an attachment on this configuration -- boxbuilder (huitzilopochtli) uploads one attachment per distinct wallpaper file, named by a content hash, and passes its filename as this var per scenario. Auto-created idempotently by boxbuilder/vulndb.py; do not hand-edit the name.
script:
#!/bin/sh
# theme-wallpaper -- sets the desktop wallpaper: system copy + per-user (XFCE/LXQt)
# config + /etc/skel (future users) + a GNOME/MATE dconf default + the LightDM/GDM
# greeter background. Reads $WALLPAPER_FILENAME, the attachment nakon places in this
# step's own working directory at build time (see nakon's attachment convention).
#
# Idempotent (safe to re-run), degrades to a no-op per mechanism when that desktop
# environment/greeter isn't installed, and handles both cold-start (file write) and
# live-session (xfconfd cache) cases.
set -e

if [ -z "$WALLPAPER_FILENAME" ]; then
    echo "[theme-wallpaper] WALLPAPER_FILENAME not set; nothing to do" >&2
    exit 0
fi

SRC="./$WALLPAPER_FILENAME"
if [ ! -f "$SRC" ]; then
    echo "[theme-wallpaper] attachment $SRC not found in the working directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

DEST_DIR=/usr/local/share/huitzilopochtli-theme
DEST="$DEST_DIR/$WALLPAPER_FILENAME"
mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
cp "$SRC" "$DEST"
chmod 644 "$DEST"

# Write the XFCE + LXQt config fragments under one .config dir (a real user's home, or
# /etc/skel, for accounts created after this ran).
nakon_write_de_config() {
    cfgdir="$1"

    xfce_dir="$cfgdir/xfce4/xfconf/xfce-perchannel-xml"
    mkdir -p "$xfce_dir"
    {
        echo '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>'
        echo '<channel name="xfce4-desktop" version="1.0">'
        echo '  <property name="backdrop" type="empty">'
        echo '    <property name="screen0" type="empty">'
        for mon in monitor0 monitorVGA-1 monitorVGA1 monitorVGA-0 monitoreDP-1 monitoreDP1 monitorLVDS1 monitorLVDS-0 monitorLVDS0 monitorHDMI-1 monitorHDMI1 monitorHDMI-0 monitorDVI-1 monitorDVI1 monitorDP-1 monitorDP1 monitordefault monitorVNC-0 monitorVNC-00 monitorVirtual-1 monitorVIRTUAL1 monitorVIRTUAL-1 monitorVirtual1; do
            for ws in workspace0 workspace1 workspace2 workspace3; do
                cat <<PROP
      <property name="$mon" type="empty">
        <property name="$ws" type="empty">
          <property name="last-image" type="string" value="$DEST"/>
          <property name="image-style" type="int" value="5"/>
        </property>
      </property>
PROP
            done
        done
        echo '    </property>'
        # Also write bare monitor entries for older XFCE that doesn't use screen0
        for mon in monitor0 monitorVGA-1 monitorVGA1 monitorVGA-0 monitoreDP-1 monitoreDP1 monitorLVDS1 monitorLVDS-0 monitorLVDS0 monitorHDMI-1 monitorHDMI1 monitorHDMI-0 monitorDVI-1 monitorDVI1 monitorDP-1 monitorDP1 monitordefault monitorVNC-0 monitorVNC-00 monitorVirtual-1 monitorVIRTUAL1 monitorVIRTUAL-1 monitorVirtual1; do
            for ws in workspace0 workspace1 workspace2 workspace3; do
                cat <<PROP2
    <property name="$mon" type="empty">
      <property name="$ws" type="empty">
        <property name="last-image" type="string" value="$DEST"/>
        <property name="image-style" type="int" value="5"/>
      </property>
    </property>
PROP2
            done
        done
        echo '  </property>'
        echo '</channel>'
    } > "$xfce_dir/xfce4-desktop.xml"

    lxqt_dir="$cfgdir/pcmanfm-qt/lxqt"
    mkdir -p "$lxqt_dir"
    cat <<INI > "$lxqt_dir/desktop-items-0.conf"
[*]
wallpaper=$DEST
wallpapermode=stretch
INI
}

# Apply to every real interactive account (uid 1000-59999, real shell, existing home).
awk -F: '($3>=1000 && $3<60000 && $7 !~ /(nologin|false)$/) {print $1":"$6}' /etc/passwd |
while IFS=: read -r nakon_u nakon_h; do
    [ -d "$nakon_h" ] || continue
    nakon_write_de_config "$nakon_h/.config"
    chown -R "$nakon_u":"$nakon_u" "$nakon_h/.config" 2>/dev/null || true
done

# Future users: /etc/skel is copied (with ownership fixed up) by `useradd -m`, so leave
# these root:root -- that's the standard skel convention.
nakon_write_de_config /etc/skel/.config

# Live-reload for already-running XFCE sessions: xfconfd caches xfce4-desktop in memory,
# so a raw XML overwrite is invisible until logout. Push the same values through the
# daemon with a throwaway bus and ask xfdesktop to reload. Best-effort, no-op if no
# session or xfconf not installed.
if command -v xfconf-query >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    for mon in monitor0 monitorVGA-1 monitorVGA1 monitorVGA-0 monitoreDP-1 monitoreDP1 monitorLVDS1 monitorLVDS-0 monitorLVDS0 monitorHDMI-1 monitorHDMI1 monitorHDMI-0 monitorDVI-1 monitorDVI1 monitorDP-1 monitorDP1 monitordefault monitorVNC-0 monitorVNC-00 monitorVirtual-1 monitorVIRTUAL1 monitorVIRTUAL-1 monitorVirtual1; do
        for ws in workspace0 workspace1 workspace2 workspace3; do
            awk -F: '($3>=1000 && $3<60000 && $7 !~ /(nologin|false)$/) {print $1}' /etc/passwd | while read -r nakon_u; do
                sudo -u "$nakon_u" dbus-launch --exit-with-session xfconf-query -c xfce4-desktop -p "/backdrop/screen0/$mon/$ws/last-image" -n -t string -s "$DEST" 2>/dev/null || true
                sudo -u "$nakon_u" dbus-launch --exit-with-session xfconf-query -c xfce4-desktop -p "/backdrop/screen0/$mon/$ws/image-style" -n -t int -s 5 2>/dev/null || true
                sudo -u "$nakon_u" dbus-launch --exit-with-session xfconf-query -c xfce4-desktop -p "/backdrop/$mon/$ws/last-image" -n -t string -s "$DEST" 2>/dev/null || true
                sudo -u "$nakon_u" dbus-launch --exit-with-session xfconf-query -c xfce4-desktop -p "/backdrop/$mon/$ws/image-style" -n -t int -s 5 2>/dev/null || true
            done
        done
    done
    # Also set the single-workspace alias that some Xubuntu configs use
    awk -F: '($3>=1000 && $3<60000 && $7 !~ /(nologin|false)$/) {print $1}' /etc/passwd | while read -r nakon_u; do
        sudo -u "$nakon_u" dbus-launch --exit-with-session xfconf-query -c xfce4-desktop -p "/backdrop/single-workspace-mode" -n -t bool -s false 2>/dev/null || true
    done
    # Ask running xfdesktop to reload (harmless if not running)
    awk -F: '($3>=1000 && $3<60000 && $7 !~ /(nologin|false)$/) {print $1}' /etc/passwd | while read -r nakon_u; do
        sudo -u "$nakon_u" dbus-launch --exit-with-session xfdesktop --reload 2>/dev/null || true
    done
fi

# GNOME + MATE system-wide default via dconf: no running session/D-Bus required.
if command -v dconf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mkdir -p /etc/dconf/db/local.d
    cat <<DCONF > /etc/dconf/db/local.d/00-huitzilopochtli-theme
[org/gnome/desktop/background]
picture-uri='file://$DEST'
picture-uri-dark='file://$DEST'
picture-options='zoom'

[org/mate/desktop/background]
picture-filename='$DEST'
DCONF
    dconf update 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# Greeter, best-effort -- each branch is a no-op when that greeter isn't installed.
if [ -f /etc/lightdm/lightdm-gtk-greeter.conf ]; then
    conf=/etc/lightdm/lightdm-gtk-greeter.conf
    if grep -q '^background=' "$conf"; then
        sed -i "s#^background=.*#background=$DEST#" "$conf"
    else
        { echo ''; echo '[greeter]'; echo "background=$DEST"; } >> "$conf"
    fi
fi
if [ -f /etc/lightdm/slick-greeter.conf ]; then
    conf=/etc/lightdm/slick-greeter.conf
    if grep -q '^background=' "$conf"; then
        sed -i "s#^background=.*#background=$DEST#" "$conf"
    else
        { echo ''; echo '[Greeter]'; echo "background=$DEST"; } >> "$conf"
    fi
fi
if [ -d /etc/dconf/profile ] && command -v dconf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mkdir -p /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d
    cat <<PROFILE > /etc/dconf/profile/gdm
user-db:user
system-db:gdm
file-db:/usr/share/gdm/greeter-dconf-defaults
PROFILE
    cat <<DCONF > /etc/dconf/db/gdm.d/00-huitzilopochtli-theme
[org/gnome/desktop/background]
picture-uri='file://$DEST'
DCONF
    dconf update 2>/dev/null || true
fi

exit 0
